name: context-actions
title: Context Actions
description: A ⋯ button that unfurls in place into a menu card with items arriving one by one: Favorite toggles, Add to album slides in a submenu, Copy link turns green, and Delete needs a 900ms hold with a red sweep, or two presses from the keyboard
